title: Generate a human-review backlog counter for CODEN AI Factory
description: Improve the CODEN software factory review queue with a small pure Python helper. Given value, a list of job-status strings, return an integer count of entries exactly equal to 'pending_review' or 'needs_review'. Count duplicates individually and ignore every other status. Use count = 0, a simple for status in value loop, and two separate if statements: compare status == 'pending_review' and status == 'needs_review' independently, increment count for each match, then return count. Avoid membership operators, boolean 'or', comprehensions, imports, helpers, network, filesystem, recursion, or external services. Generate the code yourself as a single def transform(value): function.
